# IT change request template

```markdown
## Change request: [Title]
Requested by (role): [role] | Date: [date] | Class: [Standard, Normal, Emergency]
Status: Draft

### Description
[What is changing and why]

### Business reason
[Security, compliance, efficiency, cost, user request]

### Impact
| Area | Level (High, Medium, Low, None) | Details (teams, number of people, systems) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| People | | |
| Systems | | |
| Workflows | | |
| Cost | | |

### Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Implementation
| Step | Owner role | Window | Depends on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pilot with [group] | | | |
| Full rollout | | | |

### Communication
| Audience | Message | Channel | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Rollback
Trigger: [when to roll back]
Steps: [how]
Verification: [how to confirm]

### Approvals
| Approver role | Status |
| --- | --- |
| [role] | Pending |
```
